svg.text: SET 6.0 bar a TO SAFE LOC.
SEQ. HOLD = KS-140 CLOSES ALL XV-111...114A/B (FC).
I-6 IS A PRODUCT DIVERSION, NOT A PLANT TRIP.
ESD PUSHBUTTON AND SIS LOGIC SOLVER TAGS TBC.
1. BASIS: SEE PSA-PID-001 NOTE 1. O2 PRODUCT 191 Nm3/h, 96 % O2 (Ar LUMPED) TO CUSTOMER FROM V-102 AT 3.5 bar a; N2-RICH GAS 1608 Nm3/h (88 % N2, 12 % O2) TO USERS AT ~1.2 bar a. ALL PRESSURES bar a.

2. OXYGEN SERVICE: V-102 AND ALL O2S LINES SS316L (TBC), DEGREASED AND CLEANED FOR O2 SERVICE (CGA G-4.1 / EIGA 33), NO OIL OR GREASE, O2-COMPATIBLE SOFT GOODS; VELOCITIES PER EIGA 13 (IMPINGEMENT AT PV-122,
FV-121, FV-125). PSV-102 AND XV-127 / SL-102 DISCHARGE TO A SAFE LOCATION AWAY FROM IGNITION SOURCES, PERSONNEL AND THE F-100 AIR INTAKE.

3. PV-122 HOLDS THE PRODUCT HEADER (BED TOP) AT 4.5 bar a IN AD; THE PURGE IS TAKEN UPSTREAM OF PV-122. KS-140 FORCES FV-121 CLOSED IN EQ STEPS (ELSE PRODUCT BACK-FEEDS THE EQ HEADER). NRV STOPS V-102 BACKFLOW.

4. PIC-123 (V-102 AT 3.5 bar a) OUTPUT IS THE REMOTE SP OF FIC-125 - CASCADE. AIC-124 TRIMS THE KS-140 AD STEP TIME (LONGER AD = LOWER PURITY). AT-124 PARAMAGNETIC, SAMPLE AT V-102 OUTLET, LAG ~30 s (TBC).
I-6: AT-124 < 90 % O2 CLOSES XV-126 (FC) AND OPENS XV-127 (FO) - PRODUCT DIVERSION ONLY; RETURN TO CUSTOMER BY OPERATOR RESET AFTER PURITY RECOVERS. I-5 (ESD) GIVES THE SAME VALVE ACTION.

5. CV-130 BYPASSES K-101 WHILE THE VACUUM HEADER IS ABOVE V-103 PRESSURE (BD FROM ~3.3 bar a); BELOW ~1.25 bar a K-101 TAKES OVER. HOLD: K-101 SUCTION PROTECTION WHILE SUCTION > DISCHARGE IN BD (VENDOR).

6. K-101 DISPLACEMENT 3240 m3/h ACTUAL SUCTION VOLUME (0.90 m3/s, SIMULATOR BASIS K.S0) - ONE LIQUID-RING PUMP; REV C REPLACES THE REV B ESTIMATE ~6900 m3/h AT 0.3 bar a MEAN SUCTION (EQ-EMECH-3). IT REACHES THE DESIGN END VACUUM

~0.10 bar a (0.096 IN THE SIMULATOR) AT THE END OF EV+PG (389 s) WITH 15 C SEAL WATER (FLOOR 0.029 bar a). CHECK (pid/calc_basis.py): 1244 Nm3/h PUMPED AT 0.44 bar a TIME-MEAN SUCTION = 3230 m3/h; VENDOR CURVE 1.0 > 0.10 bar a TO MATCH.

SEAL WATER: PARTIAL RECIRCULATION FROM V-104, SERVICE-WATER MAKE-UP HOLDS RING TEMPERATURE (TI-132), EXCESS OVERFLOWS VIA LOOP SEAL TO DRAIN; SEAL-WATER COOLER IF REQUIRED (TBC). FSLL-137 TRIPS K-101 (I-2).
7. N2-RICH GAS (~12 % O2) IS OXYGEN-DEFICIENT - ASPHYXIATION HAZARD: HV-136 AND PSV-103 VENT TO A SAFE ELEVATED LOCATION; AT-135 MONITORS N2 PURITY TO USERS.
8. VAC LINES AND V-104 GAS SIDE ARE SUB-ATMOSPHERIC IN EV: VACUUM-TIGHT JOINTS (AIR INGRESS DILUTES THE N2-RICH GAS). VESSEL VENTS / DRAINS SHOWN (REV B). LINE SIZES PRELIMINARY - TBC BY PIPING.

9. PT-123 ROOT VALVE HV-185 SHOWN, LO (FEEDS PIC-123 AND I-4); PT-122/131/133 c/w ROOT AND TEST VALVES (TYP., NOT SHOWN). SW MAKE-UP THROTTLE VALVE TAGGED HV-189 (REV B). ACTIONS OF I-1...I-4 ARE PROPOSED - CONFIRM IN C&E / HAZOP.

10. HAND VALVES (REV B): NORMALLY OPEN UNLESS MARKED NC / LO (LOCKED OR CAR-SEALED OPEN) / LC; LO VALVES CLOSED ONLY UNDER PERMIT WITH THE UNIT STOPPED. PSV-102 / PSV-103 INLET VALVES HV-184 / HV-192 ARE LO; OUTLETS TO ATMOSPHERE, NO
OUTLET VALVES. SAMPLE POINTS HV-186 (O2, CHECK OF AT-124) AND HV-194 (N2-RICH, CHECK OF AT-135): O2-CLEAN, 1/2" c/w PLUG. VENTS / DRAINS 1" c/w PLUG. HAND-VALVE LIST: OTS P&ID TAB.
HAND VALVES, VENTS AND DRAINS ADDED
